1 tin of crushed tomatoes (organic tastes best, look for tomatoes from sunny places; sun = flavour) 1-2 sticks of celerey 1 carrot 1 pack of white beans in water (whatever type floats your boat) worcheseschsesaseesire sauce (too lazy to google correct spelling) seasoning (salt, pepper, paprika + whatever you like) cooking oil (olive / any veg oil)

Tear of the strings of the celery (crack it at the bottom and pull your little broken piece upwards). Finely chop the celery and carrots (the finer it's chopped the better, use a mandolin if you have it), pulverise those veggie bastards (or leave it chunky, some people are weird like that).

Cook your finely chopped veg on medium/high heat with a few glugs of oil. Don't let it get hot enough to go brown, you want it to go soft and see-through, should only take a few minutes. Add your tomatoes and a tablespoon of W-sauce, and let it simmer over medium heat, evaporating all excess water. Once unwanted water is gone and you are happy with the thickness, season the mixture to taste. Cook beans according to packet instructions, I usually buy ones that just need heating up and add them towards the end. Make sure you rinse the beans before you add them, and don't add any extra water to the mixture when you add the beans.

Enjoy!
